I called my doctor's surgery at Broomfield Medical Centre and was told to ring back at 9 am. So, I started calling at 8:45, managed to get through to an operator at 8:54, only to be told they don't go online till nine and that I'd have to go back in the queue behind 30 other people. The operator said hopefully they could fit me in for an appointment, but honestly, I decided to give that a miss and got a friend to drive me down instead. I arrived at the surgery at 8:59 and tried explaining my situation to the
receptionist who was incredibly argumentative and not at all helpful. Thankfully, I was able to get an appointment at 9:02, but if I'd had to wait in that queue, I probably wouldn't have got one at all. It's beyond frustrating having to time your calls precisely just to get anywhere near the front of the line, which is almost impossible unless you have multiple phones and stagger your calls over several minutes.
What made matters worse was the receptionist this morning, who should have been calming things down but just escalated the situation instead. The customer service was absolutely appalling. She claimed there were eight staff answering the phones, yet somehow they still manage to take on too many patients and have far too few appointments available. It's a good job I'm not simply ridiculous.
